newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bear Stearns lowers EPS estimate on Apasco.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns lowers EPS estimate on Apasco.

text.p: Bear Stearns has revised downward its earnings estimates for Mexican cement firm Apasco because of expected lower prices, lower exports and higher production costs.
Analysts Sobani Warner and Daniel Altman wrote in a report that the 1997 estimate has been cut to $2.16 per ADR from $2.27, and the 1998 forecast has been cut to $2.78 from $3.01.

"Currently, we don't predict any real price increases for cement in 1997, and a real increase of two percent for 1998," the analysts wrote. "Previously we had predicted a real increase of two percent for both years."
